candidate_boundary: In-scope candidates are named coding-agent or CLI host surfaces with install or discovery mechanisms, agent-facing extension points, repository workspace access, and a CLI invocation or bootstrap path. IDE-only, CI-only, and hosted review surfaces are future evidence only and cannot be selected adapter targets in this slug.

agent_cli_install_distribution.note: Copilot CLI has documented install paths and plugin marketplace sources.

cli_bundling_bootstrap.note: Pinned installs, custom homes, plugin directories, and local marketplaces support deterministic bootstrap.

filesystem_access.note: Read, write, and shell tool grants can operate in trusted directories with scoped path filters.

cli_invocation.note: Programmatic prompt mode and tool allow/deny flags support scripted CLI invocation.

cli_report_rendering.note: Silent stdout, Markdown transcript export, Gist export, and GitHub Actions summaries can surface CLI reports.

annotation_apis.note: Hooks can approve, deny, or inject context, but no public REST/event-bus annotation API is documented.

background_runs.note: Autopilot, fleet subagents, session ids, and CI examples support background or unattended runs.

repair_action_ui.note: Plan mode, permission prompts, rollback snapshots, and remote approvals support repair preview and approval flows.

trace_deep_links.note: Share Gists and remote session URLs exist, but no structured per-step trace deep-link API is documented.

evidence.note: Install docs list npm, winget, Homebrew, install script, and binary release paths.
Install and release evidence covers pinned versions, COPILOT_HOME, plugin-dir controls, and local marketplace bootstrap.
Programmatic reference documents read, write, shell, trusted directories, --add-dir, and path-scoped tool filters.
Programmatic invocation supports prompts, stdin, no-ask mode, tool filters, model/agent selection, and secret env vars.
Automation docs show captured output and Markdown summaries suitable for report rendering.
Hooks provide structured feedback injection, but no dedicated annotation persistence API is documented.
Autopilot and fleet capabilities support unattended and parallel work.
Rollback snapshots, plan approval, permission dialogs, and remote approvals support repair workflows.
Share URLs exist for transcripts, but formal item-level trace deep links are not documented.

Extension docs support vendored scripts and release assets but not automatic npm dependency resolution.
File-system docs cover read, write, list, glob, grep, and replace tools.
Shell tool docs support foreground and background command execution.
Headless docs describe stream-json output and typed events for downstream renderers.
Hooks expose JSON event data but not a native durable annotation surface.
Roadmap lists background agents; current shell/headless behavior is enough for CLI redirects but not rich background sessions.

hosts.stage9_scope_summary: Keep Gemini CLI as CLI-first fallback evidence until bootstrap and background-agent capabilities are proven enough for a limited adapter.

plugin_capability.note: plugin-capability is the per-host row type for the capability matrix with tiers, surface kind, stable evidence ids, evidence entries, and fallback behavior.

repair_action.note: Current repair-action shape supports preview-backed repair proposals, but limited adapters without host preview and approval affordances need an advisory-only repair mode before writes are exposed through an adapter.

adapter_scope_metadata.note: Adapter implementations must add a schema-backed adapter scope manifest or equivalent revalidated plugin-capability metadata to prove implemented scope is a subset of capability-matrix evidence.

decision.rationale: Codex CLI, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot CLI are in-scope limited-adapter candidates; Gemini CLI remains CLI-first fallback because bootstrap and background-agent support are only partial. GitHub Copilot CLI has the strongest first-target evidence for marketplace/plugin distribution, CLI bootstrap, hooks, MCP/skills, background runs, and repair approval, while annotation and trace deep-link UX must remain advisory or unavailable.
